description:
**Phase A — Foundation. Deps: none (parallel with A1/A2).**

No per-session token accumulation exists today. AIEvent.Done flows through `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex:100-115, 203-211` carrying usage implicitly but nothing consumes it.

- Add running total to `OctoPi.Agent.Session` state.
- Update from `OctoPi.Agent.Loop` on each completion via `OctoPi.AI.Usage` (input/output/cache_read/cache_write/total_tokens — see apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/usage.ex:12-26).
- Wire `api.get_context_usage/0` (currently stub returning nil — apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/api.ex:38) to return the accumulator.

Tests: port `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/agent-session-stats.test.ts`.
title: A3. Session-level token accumulator
